currencyNote.text: Brazil adopted the real in July 1994. Earlier years are older currencies converted to reais by the World Bank, so they are not amounts anyone held at the time.
Germany adopted the euro in 1999 (notes and coins in 2002). Earlier years are Deutsche Marks converted at the fixed rate of 1.95583 per euro.
France adopted the euro in 1999 (notes and coins in 2002). Earlier years are French francs converted at the fixed rate of 6.55957 per euro.
Italy adopted the euro in 1999 (notes and coins in 2002). Earlier years are Italian lire converted at the fixed rate of 1936.27 per euro.
Spain adopted the euro in 1999 (notes and coins in 2002). Earlier years are Spanish pesetas converted at the fixed rate of 166.386 per euro.
Netherlands adopted the euro in 1999 (notes and coins in 2002). Earlier years are Dutch guilders converted at the fixed rate of 2.20371 per euro.
Poland redenominated the złoty in 1995 (1 new złoty = 10,000 old). Earlier years are converted by the World Bank, so they are not amounts anyone held at the time.
Mexico introduced the new peso in 1993 (1 new peso = 1,000 old). Earlier years are converted by the World Bank, so they are not amounts anyone held at the time.
Türkiye introduced the new lira in 2005 (1 new lira = 1,000,000 old). Earlier years are converted by the World Bank, so they are not amounts anyone held at the time.
